heading: Companions
empty: Turn on a layer to meet its companion
foot: Click a companion for its numbers; interactions are illustrative, not cause and effect.
interactionNote: Interactions are illustrative; they do not show cause and effect.
voiceTitle: Read the selected companion's words aloud (browser voice)
narrateTitle: When on, a companion speaks up when you turn on a layer, change place or pause

shape.above: Shape: above its usual for the month.
shape.near: Shape: near its usual for the month.
shape.below: Shape: below its usual for the month.

line.noData: {{name}} at {{place}}, {{month}}: no data for this month.
line.equal: That equals the {{monthName}} mean of this record ({{usual}}, {{first}} to {{last}}).
line.above: That is {{size}} above the {{monthName}} mean of this record ({{usual}}, {{first}} to {{last}}).
line.below: That is {{size}} below the {{monthName}} mean of this record ({{usual}}, {{first}} to {{last}}).

say.noData: I have no data for {{place}} in {{month}}.
say.above: That is {{size}} above the usual for {{monthName}}.
say.below: That is {{size}} below the usual for {{monthName}}.
say.rising: Since {{year}} this has risen by about {{change}} per decade, and the change holds up in the statistical tests.
say.falling: Since {{year}} this has fallen by about {{change}} per decade, and the change holds up in the statistical tests.
say.risingRawOnly: Since {{year}} this has risen by about {{change}} per decade, but the evidence is weak: it passes the basic test, not the stricter one.
say.fallingRawOnly: Since {{year}} this has fallen by about {{change}} per decade, but the evidence is weak: it passes the basic test, not the stricter one.
say.notSignificant: Since {{year}}, no clear change shows in this record. That is not the same as no change.
say.unreliable: The record gives about {{change}} per decade since {{year}}, but this number is not reliable. The data itself has a documented problem: {{reason}}
say.insufficient: There is too little data here to work out a trend.

gallery.title: Data companions
gallery.postures: Posture (same companion): below usual, near usual, above usual, no data
gallery.foot: Drawn by code (SVG). Size: value within the series' own range. Posture: month against the mean of the same calendar month. Mark: ▲ ▼ significant trend, ◇ not significant, a crossed-out triangle for a significant trend that is not reliable as a climate signal.

gather.foot: In the middle, a form of the sky or air points up and a form of the surface or ground holds a palm down; higher forms stand on the upper steps. The arrangement is illustrative and shows no cause and effect.
gather.credit: Composition inspired by Raphael, The School of Athens (1509–1511), public domain.
gather.title: Group view
